column1: # Owners that Zorin OS 18.1 Core ships with and NoctraOS images lost (iso/build-noctraos-iso.sh used
# `mksquashfs -all-root`, which flattened every file to root:root; fixed, but images built that way exist).
# Read by migrations/system/0001_restore_ownership.sh. Columns, tab separated: path, user, group, flag.
# flag "R" applies to everything below the path that is still root:root. Only files that are exactly
# root:root are touched, so an owner someone set on purpose is never overwritten. Modes were never lost.
# Generated from the stock squashfs: `unsquashfs -lln` entries whose uid or gid is not 0, names from its
# own /etc/passwd and /etc/group; /run, /home and the man cache children are left out (the last as one R line).
